player.title: JPlay player
player.description: The address of the Raspberry Pi running JPlay. Players on your network usually show up by themselves.

jplayingnow.title: JPlaying Now display
jplayingnow.description: The address of the JPlaying Now Pi. Displays (version 2 and later) usually show up by themselves.

hub.title: JPlay hub
hub.description: The address of the Pi that is the hub (port 8090). It usually shows up by itself.

zeroconf_confirm_hub.title: JPlay hub found
zeroconf_confirm_hub.description: Add the JPlay hub ({host})? It shows what plays in every room, today's totals and the last record put on.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach a JPlay player there. Check the address and that JPlay runs (port 8080).
error.cannot_connect_now: Can't reach JPlaying Now there, or it is an older version without Home Assistant support (update it first).
error.cannot_connect_hub: Can't reach a JPlay hub there. Check the address and that the hub runs (port 8090).
